evaluator_independence.rule: The evaluator must not import src.cre_foundry.economics or any economics material-implementation module. It independently renders the canonical COMMERCIAL_ECONOMICS_MODEL subject and its two registered diagnostics from the pinned schema and fixtures.

rejected.reason: A rehashed receipt can bless a coordinated semantic rehash.
Shared economics or cost errors can pass both paths.
Shape checks cannot prove omitted-cost or modeled-as-realized separation.

canonical_serialization.rule: UTF-8 canonical JSON uses sorted keys, integer numbers only, and separators comma/colon; stale set-semantics arrays are sorted before hashing.

pass_rule: The canonical clean subject passes with zero diagnostics, both registered mutations fail with their exact diagnostic, and no real firm economics or realized-value claim is made.
claim_ceiling: Public proof level 5 establishes deterministic, replayable conformance of the synthetic risk-adjusted expected net commercial value engine, its cost, downside, uncertainty, and fallback machinery, and its registered mutations only. It establishes no firm-authoritative economics, no realized commercial value, no calibrated real uncertainty, no commercial lift, no production readiness, no deployment readiness, no field effectiveness, no scaled-evaluator independence, and no hidden-holdout performance.
implementation_gate: Do not credit or begin material economics implementation until this contract, contracts/commercial_economics.schema.json, and contracts/economic_engine.schema.json are independently swept and frozen, the evaluator independently emits the two registered diagnostics on their mutations and zero diagnostics on the clean subject, and independent post-repair sweeps are clean.
